attempts.rationale: Robust baseline: median handles unstable ranking and correlated error groups without weight estimation; series is seasonal_dominated with robust combination hint
Robust combination different from median: trims top/bottom 20% of forecasts to reduce influence of extreme predictions, motivated by unstable ranking and high forecast disagreement in test window.

Strong seasonality and unstable rankings favor a directionally-adaptive robust method; DBA can adapt to local seasonal patterns unlike static trimmed_mean or median
Smaller diverse pool (4 error groups) with robust trimming to handle unstable ranking; tests whether reducing correlated models helps
Per-horizon top-5 SMAPE weighting to exploit unstable cross-window ranking; different models lead at different horizons in a seasonal series
Caruana forward selection exploits error complementarity across the 4 correlation groups, a different axis than individual error ranking which is unstable here (tau=-0.224)
Testing if simple equal-weight mean matches robust methods when rankings are unstable and pool diversity is the main driver
Testing softmax weighting on full pool: more concentrated than inverse_error but still robust to ranking instability; different from w2 which used linear 1/error
With unstable rankings and strong seasonality, different models may dominate at different horizon steps; one-hot per-step selection avoids diluting the best model at each step with weaker ones
Top-3 per horizon: captures horizon-specific model strengths under strong seasonality and unstable rankings, softer than one-hot best_per_horizon
One representative from each of 5 distinct error-correlation groups to test cross-group complementarity vs full-pool mean; motivated by unstable rankings (tau=-0.224) and robust combination hint
